messages:
emily: FYI I'm drafting the release note for the docs site about the SDK rename + anchor tidy. Need owners for snippet updates and a short known-issues blurb.
jorge: I can take Go + Rust snippets. Which pages?
emily: Mostly docs/sdk/go/quickstart.md, docs/sdk/rust/overview.md, and the whats-new entry. Also we broke some anchors under /whats-new after the heading reshuffle.
doc-bot: linkcheck: 5 failed anchors detected. Log attached in PR 6677.
jorge: OK will update sample init calls (`NewRedwood()` -> `Redwood::new()`) and add a one-line migration note.
qa-mia: Tag me when PRs are up. I'll run a quick smoke against staging Dedicated (short + long generates). Watch APAC streaming fallback — saw partial chunking Monday.
emily: Known issues suggestion: "Embeddings streaming deprecation may yield partial chunks in APAC; legacy alias retained for one release; netlify redirect TTL ~30m can cause transient anchor failures." Add to changelog under 'known_issues'.
harry: I'll take the whats-new blurb wording. One ask: avoid the phrase 'breaking change' — say 'API rename' and link migration guide.
emily: Good call. Draft bullet: "SDK: API rename — client class and a few parameter names changed. See migration guide; a legacy shim is provided for one release."
jorge: Pushed PR 6678 for Go/Rust snippet updates and a tiny compatibility shim for Go.
doc-bot: deploy: whats-new staging build queued; redirect TTL note: netlify shows 20-40m TTL.
qa-mia: I'll run verification Thursday 09:00 PT. Please include staging link + quick test steps in PR.
emily: Plan: merge snippet + anchor PRs, QA signoff, then publish whats-new and final changelog. ETA: EOD Friday. Thanks all!
